best_idea: Group overlay sprites by draw state and rasterise the overlay layer into a cache that re-rasterises only when its content changes or a slow timer fires, so 40 nameplates cost one blit on most frames.
decision_why: Nameplates and bars are the main overlay load in many-vs-one fights; take the state grouping and the change-or-timer cache for slow layers, keep fight-critical HUD per frame, and fix the dead force flag, the one-frame shader lag and the hash-only state equality.
acceptance: In a 3-vs-1 fight with 20 visible nameplates on a 375-wide phone, a dev counter shows the static overlay layer costs one blit per frame when nothing changed, and the hit number and own health bar update on the same frame as the hit (per-frame layer, not the 10 Hz layer).
